external_entities.name: Suppliers
external_entities.description: Suppliers who upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category managers
external_entities.description: Corporate category managers who review supplier paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor that hosts the SaaS portal and pushes the nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: Vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: Service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor's platform
data_stores.description: Vendor-hosted platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: Bucket in our cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: Database in our cloud account into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: Suppliers upload to Supplier document portal
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff

data_flows.name: Category managers review Supplier document portal
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded supplier compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions

data_flows.name: Vendor pushes nightly extract to Landing bucket
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a supplier data extract to the landing bucket every night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says the nightly extract is encrypted end to end, but the landing-bucket runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is. These claims conflict.

data_flows.name: Supplier master service loads Landing bucket
data_flows.description: The supplier master service picks up and loads the file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: Supplier master service writes Supplier database
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes the extracted records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract

assumptions.assumption: The contents of the vendor's platform are confidential because it stores compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because it receives supplier data extracts.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the landing bucket receives a supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data because it stores supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
